entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Ajay Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Dept. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Rajeshwar,Rakesh Kumar Nayak
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.38 of 2024 under sections 376. 504 & 506 IPC and section 67 of IT Act, P.S. Aalapur, District Ambedkar Nagar.

3. In terms of the FIR lodged on 04.03.2024, it was alleged that on 16.02.2024 at about 4:00 pm,
the applicant allured the victim and committed wrong on her and also threatened to harm her husband.
It was also stated that inappropriate photographs were taken and made viral on the facebook.
In the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim reiterated the said version.
In the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim reiterated the version and stated that in the agricultural fields, the offence was committed.

The medical of the victim was done on 05.03.2024 in Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86790578/
1 which there was no corroboration of any allegation.

entities.text: Ajay Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There were no sign of use of force.

4. Considering the inordinate delay in lodging the FIR, coupled with the fact that the age of victim is around 32 years and the medical does not corroborate, a case for bail is made out more so when the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 05.03.2024.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Ajay Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.7.2024 VNP/-
